record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, untie input and output item embeddings: retain the existing input table and introduce one independently parameterized output table within each category's single network, initialized by copying the input table. Use the output table consistently for positive, negative and candidate dot products. Separate context and target roles may improve expressiveness without the norm restriction that previously regressed. Preserve dimensions, features, backbone, readout, loss and optimizer; update checkpoint loading and predictor construction.

category_rationales.rationale: Untie context and target item embeddings in each category's single NextItNet model. Initialize the trainable output table by copying the input table, preserving dimensions, backbone, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer. The predictor writer imports the updated model class, so checkpoints and inference remain consistent.
